plugin_info.details: This plugin analyzes the docking scores of both known-active and other (inactive or decoy) compounds to assess how well docking prioritizes the known actives.
plugin_info.intro: Calculate receiver operating characteristic and enrichment factor curves.
plugin_info.title: Evaluate Docking Performance

user_args.description: Label to identify compounds that are active (per experiment). The names of all actives must contain this text.
Label to identify other compounds (inactives or decoys). The names of all compounds that are not known actives must contain this text.
If checked, label case will be ignored. For example, the label "active" will match compounds with names containing "Active" and "ACTIVE".
user_args.label: Labels are case insensitive
